# The arrival of a_jpy_arrival_booked_to_the_directors_account.txt given a
# third split, 0 JPY on the yen bank with no value stated, for
# `--strategy update`.
#
# A split added on the yen bank makes every split on it read again, from what
# the bank held without the transaction before the edit opened: 0 JPY. So the
# arrival still brings in its 100,000 JPY, the cost basis is what it was, and
# the edit goes through.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_an_edit_may_move_the_split_that_sets_the_rate.py.
